import.title: Import customers with their history
import.intro: Add your customers from your old database (another app or an Excel file) with their history. Their score and level (Very reliable, Risky…) show in Pilotix right away, instead of “New”.
import.ordersFile: Or the file of all the orders of your old app (one row per order, with Phone, Status — or Confirmation status and Delivery status — and Date): Pilotix counts each customer’s delivered, refused, fake and cancelled orders by itself.
import.rules: * required. The first row of the first sheet holds the column names (French, English or Arabic). Nothing is deleted: a customer already in Pilotix keeps their name and orders, only their old history is added. Importing the same customer again replaces their old history (it does not add up).
import.levels: Levels from the file (with your Customer score points):
import.noHistory: No history column (Delivered, Refused, Fake, Cancelled): these customers will arrive as “New”.
import.safe: Nothing is saved before “Import”. The shop’s numbers (dashboard, stats, pay) never count this old history: only the customers’ score uses it.
